messages:
Maria (CS): quick heads-up on Polaris — we're getting a spike in signals for a realtime personalization use case. mobile team wants in-app recommendations + short generative snippets. they're asking about latency under 200ms and an embeddings+gen flow.
Jamal (AE): nice. renewal is Q3 still on? any churn risk if we don't hit latency?
Maria (CS): renewal still expected but they're sensitive. they want a week-long production pilot before they commit to renewal — bit nervous they might shop alternatives if integration drags :grimacing:
Olivia (CSE): can you share expected traffic shape? avg qps, burst, request types? and which SDKs are they on?
Maria (CS): SDK: mobile iOS/Android (latest). traffic: baseline ~50 rps, bursts to ~450 rps during promotions. embeddings ~20k/day, gen ~10k/day. avg generation length ~40 tokens. target: <200ms p90 for gen responses.
Simon (SRE): 450 rps bursts + gen is nontrivial. at 40 tokens avg that's ~18k tokens/s at peak. recommend Dedicated or a dedicated pre-warmed pool + KV prefix caching for user histories.
Olivia (CSE): agree. propose prefix/KV cache + batching window tuning. can we quantify cost delta between hosted+optimizations vs Dedicated? I can run numbers if we pick a model variant.
Maria (CS): customer is testing a gpt-compatible open checkpoint (small-medium). they also asked if Redwood supports fallback to a smaller quantized variant during overload.
Simon (SRE): yes — we can do routing fallback to an 8-bit quantized model. recommend policy: route to primary until latency >220ms then fallback for affected customer ids. this needs a canary rollout and a Console config.
Jamal (AE): let's schedule a call with the Polaris PM this week. want to demo Dedicated burst mode + the rollout plan and discuss pilot pricing.
Maria (CS): PM available Thu 10:00am PST. inviting Olivia + Simon. Jamal, can you lead the commercial/pilot pricing ask?
Jamal (AE): will do.
Olivia (CSE): prep checklist for the call:
- expected qps and P90/P95 targets
- recommended model variants and quantization profiles
- caching strategy + KV prefix examples
- rollout plan: canary + auto-fallback policy
- pilot SLA and monitoring (Console dashboards, token/cost breakdown)
Maria (CS): I'll send the customer's telemetry snapshot and SDK logs before the call. attaching a tiny anonymized sample here:
```
# sample event: anonymized
{"user_id":"u_***","event":"request","type":"embed+gen","tokens":42,"latency_ms":152}
```
Simon (SRE): thanks — i'll draft a Dedicated config, fallback routing rules, and estimate GPU-hours. will post before EOD Wed.
Olivia (CSE): i'll prepare cost vs perf slides + a couple of repro prompts for latency.
Maria (CS): note on renewal: if pilot goes well we should recommend a committed monthly burst plan + reserved capacity. if not, theres a risk of a longer procurement cycle.
Jamal (AE): triaging as priority. thanks all :thumbsup:
eng-bot: meeting created: Polaris Pilot — Thu 10:00 PST (calendar invite sent)
